content.value: A young pair of rabbits is placed on an island. A pair of rabbits does not breed until they (15) [CO4] are 2 months old, each pair of rabbits produces another pair each month. Find a recurrence relation along with its closed form for the numbers of pairs of rabbits on the is-land after n months if all the rabbits are alive.
